decisions.quote: Our results replicate those found by Tversky ( 1977 ), revealing an average diagnosticity-effect of 4.75%. However, when we eliminate the possibility of substitution effects confounding the results, a meta-analysis of the data provides no indication of any remaining effect of diagnosticity.
decisions.reason: The authors conclude that their results replicate the original choice pattern in Tversky (1977) overall, but show that the original paradigm is confounded by substitution effects and that no overall diagnosticity effect remains once that confound is eliminated, which is 'statistically successful but flawed' rather than 'mixed'.

decisions.quote: In Study 2 we attempted to replicate Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ) which was reported in Tversky ( 1977 ) as the second study providing support for the diagnosticity effect.
decisions.reason: Addressing the prior adjudication and parent_objection explicitly: the source text establishes that Study 2 in Tversky (1977) and Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati (1978) are two published reports of the exact same original country-similarity diagnosticity experiment (20 sets of 4 countries, N = 33, with diagnosticity effects of 11.8% on choices for b and 11.6% on choices for c), where Tversky (1977) reported the study in summary form and Tversky and Gati (1978) described the same experiment in greater procedural and statistical detail ('Study 2 on the diagnosticity principle, (described in more detail as Experiment 4 in Tversky and Gati, 1978 ) is a conceptual replication using semantic stimuli'). The codebook's 'closest study in the chain' rule applies to replication chains where a finding was subsequently re-tested by others, not to summary versus full companion reports of the same original experiment by the original authors. Under the candidate review report-equivalence rules—which require confirming the absence of the original work/finding across all shipped rows under alternate citations or preliminary/full reports—this underlying original experiment and finding are already represented by shipped row 919 (Tversky, 1977, 10.1037/0033-295x.84.4.327), so Tversky and Gati (1978) is not an independent omitted original. Note also that Luna's identity_quote failed mechanical validation by omitting the space before the closing parenthesis in 'Tversky and Gati, 1978 )'.
